title: Smiling Mother & Son on Brick Front Steps, May 1950 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A charming snapshot from May 1950 capturing a mother and her young son seated together on the brick steps of their home. The mother is dressed in a dark short-sleeve dress and open-toe strappy shoes with neatly styled hair, smiling warmly toward the camera, while the boy sits beside her wearing a patterned sweater vest and trousers. Next to the porch, a large bush is in full spring bloom. The image embodies the warmth and simplicity of post-World War II American domestic family life at the onset of the 1950s.
